title: CMS editor profile created by unauthenticated request before script upload
abstract_chain: unauthenticated actor reaches editor configuration path
new editor profile or upload policy appears without admin session
script-like file is placed in web-accessible path
web server process later touches the uploaded artifact
defensive_focus: block unauthenticated configuration writes
alert on editor profile creation without admin context
monitor web roots for executable file creation
correlate CMS audit logs with web process behavior
safety_note: Use a mock CMS route and inert file markers; do not include executable PHP payloads.

title: VPN session established without normal credential and device assurance chain
abstract_chain: legacy VPN mode remains enabled
remote session appears without expected password/MFA/device-certificate evidence
session immediately accesses internal systems
identity system treats access as normal VPN login
defensive_focus: disable deprecated VPN modes
require machine certificates and MFA
correlate VPN sessions with IdP assurance events
alert on first-seen VPN source followed by lateral movement
safety_note: Model the login and post-login telemetry only; do not reproduce protocol exploitation.

title: SD-WAN management API attempts file write outside approved directory
abstract_chain: authenticated low-privilege account calls upload or import API
submitted path escapes intended directory scope
device records file creation outside approved area
subsequent management behavior changes or privileged file is touched
defensive_focus: enforce strict path normalization
deny file writes outside allowlisted directories
separate read-only accounts from upload/import permissions
record path digest and caller identity in audit logs
safety_note: Use placeholder path tokens such as OUTSIDE_ALLOWED_DIR rather than real device paths.

title: Package install hook reads CI secrets and opens outbound connection
abstract_chain: dependency is added or version resolves to new artifact
install lifecycle script executes before application code review
script enumerates environment variable names and local credential files
outbound connection is attempted during build
defensive_focus: run dependency installation in network-restricted sandbox
block install scripts for untrusted packages
detect secret-like variable access during build
require provenance and lockfile review for dependency updates
safety_note: Use fake secret variable names and a local sink; do not use real exfiltration endpoints.

title: Python wheel uses startup side effect instead of package import
abstract_chain: wheel is installed in build environment
startup metadata or loader file causes code to run during interpreter initialization
execution happens before the application imports the package
build system lacks telemetry for interpreter startup side effects
defensive_focus: inspect wheel metadata and startup hooks
disable untrusted package execution in build stages
compare expected module behavior with install-time behavior
alert on interpreter startup files from new dependencies
safety_note: Represent startup hooks as inert metadata markers only.

title: Semver range pulls compromised package version into cached build
abstract_chain: manifest permits a broad version range
registry receives a malicious or compromised version
CI cache or package manager resolves different artifact than prior build
scanner only checks source manifest and misses resolved artifact
defensive_focus: pin exact versions with lockfile enforcement
record resolved package digest
scan cached artifacts and build output
alert when resolved digest changes without reviewed manifest change
safety_note: Use toy package names and fake digests.

title: Agent skill manifest understates behavior compared with implementation
abstract_chain: skill declares narrow read-only utility behavior
implementation requests filesystem, shell, network, or credential access
agent grants permissions based on manifest trust
runtime behavior exceeds declared purpose
defensive_focus: compare declared capabilities with observed behavior
require behavioral integrity verification before install
deny hidden privilege expansion
produce skill risk score before agent execution
safety_note: Use synthetic skills with no real shell access.

title: MCP tool metadata contains instruction-like text that conflicts with user policy
abstract_chain: agent discovers external MCP tool
tool description includes instruction-like content not visible to end user
agent planning treats metadata as trusted guidance
agent attempts action outside user-approved task
defensive_focus: sanitize tool descriptions
separate tool metadata from instructions
apply tool allowlist and action policy
log tool-originated text that influences planning
safety_note: Use benign placeholder instructions and no real credential or command text.

title: AI malware scanner receives package text that attempts to alter scanner behavior
abstract_chain: scanner extracts comments, README, or code strings from package
artifact contains text that looks like instructions to the scanner
LLM-based analyzer may follow artifact instructions instead of system policy
risk score is reduced or analysis is truncated
defensive_focus: treat artifact text as data not instructions
wrap extracted text with strict provenance labels
detect token flooding and safety-triggering text
compare LLM result with static heuristics
safety_note: Use harmless prompt-injection canaries such as SCANNER_IGNORE_CANARY.

title: Cloud audit log sink modified to reduce defender visibility
abstract_chain: principal obtains cloud permissions related to logging
log sink, trail, bucket, retention, or subscription is modified
security analytics receives fewer or delayed events
other suspicious actions occur after logging change
defensive_focus: protect logging configuration with separate admin boundary
alert on disablement or sink destination changes
write logs to immutable cross-account storage
correlate logging changes with subsequent privileged actions
safety_note: Use synthetic cloud audit events; do not change real cloud logging resources.

title: Cloud logs are copied to unexpected external destination
abstract_chain: logging export or subscription is added
destination is outside approved account or organization
attacker gains continuous visibility into resource names, identities, and activity timing
future attacks adapt based on observed defender actions
defensive_focus: allowlist log destinations
detect cross-account log export
classify audit logs as sensitive data
require change approval for log subscriptions
safety_note: Use mock account IDs and local log events only.

title: Edge appliance compromise has weak endpoint telemetry and delayed containment
abstract_chain: internet-facing VPN, gateway, router, or network appliance is exploited or misused
device lacks normal endpoint agent visibility
attacker uses appliance as staging point or lateral movement pivot
incident team has limited forensic data
defensive_focus: reduce management exposure
collect appliance-native logs centrally
monitor outbound flows from edge devices
prepare vendor-specific triage checklist
safety_note: Model network flows and config changes; do not target real devices.
